request.text: I'm choosing between two airport buses. The express reaches Terminal 2 at 7:55, while the local reaches it at 7:50. My check-in opens at 8:00. Which one gives me more time before check-in?

responsibilities.outcome: Compare the stated airport-bus arrival times and tell the user which option provides more time before check-in opens.

new_goals.description: Determine which stated airport-bus arrival provides more time before the 8:00 check-in opening.
new_goals.source_text: I'm choosing between two airport buses. The express reaches Terminal 2 at 7:55, while the local reaches it at 7:50. My check-in opens at 8:00. Which one gives me more time before check-in?
constraints: Use only the arrival and check-in times supplied by the user.
success_criteria: Compare both pre-check-in intervals and identify the option with the larger interval.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The request expresses one self-contained comparison Goal grounded by r1.

semantic_facts: The local bus arrives ten minutes before check-in opens, while the express arrives five minutes before it opens, so the local provides five more minutes based on the supplied times.
forbidden_claims: The assistant checked live transit data, verified either bus's punctuality, booked transport, or guaranteed that either interval is sufficient for the trip.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner invokes an external lookup even though all facts needed for the comparison are admitted in the request.
The planner replaces a bounded time comparison with unsupported claims about live schedules or trip feasibility.
